title: Self-healing macros
body: Self-healing macros: macro_repair_apply rewrites a brittle CSS selector into its semantic click_by/fill_by (from the role/label/text captured at record time) and saves it in place — no hand-editing JSON.

title: Snapshots follow you into iframes
body: Snapshots follow you into iframes: after browser_switch_frame, browser_snapshot and browser_brief show the frame you're in, not the parent page (capture / golden / read_markdown too).

title: Disconnect-aware
body: Disconnect-aware: if octowright's MCP server drops, you're told to reconnect it in your client instead of silently opening a browser it can't drive, inspect, or record.

title: This what's-new notice itself
body: This 'what's new' notice itself — shown once on the first run after an update, and in octowright_status.
